description: Intended Atlas alert conditions (Admin API v2 alertConfigs) for the primary and ledger clusters, and which a tier can actually raise. Established 2026-09-30 from live API responses, the official Admin API OpenAPI spec (mongodb/openapi v2.json) and the Atlas UI: a Free (M0) cluster has NO native metric alert. LOGICAL_SIZE exists only as a host metric (OUTSIDE_METRIC_THRESHOLD, host matchers only; refused with CLUSTER_NAME, and host metrics are not collected on Free); OUTSIDE_SERVERLESS_METRIC_THRESHOLD accepts only SERVERLESS_* series (refused LOGICAL_SIZE: METRIC_NAME_AND_EVENT_TYPE_MISMATCH) that belong to the Serverless product; OUTSIDE_FLEX_METRIC_THRESHOLD (FLEX_* series, CLUSTER_NAME matcher) applies to Flex clusters only, even though the generic UI lists it. Accepting any of these on M0 would be monitoring that never fires, so nothing is rendered for Free; every intended alert is listed as unavailable. Flex rendering is added only when a Flex cluster exists and its names are verified live.

alerts.why: Approaching the 100 ops/s cap (Free: throttled; Flex: next price tier)
One operation type using 40% of the cap
Transactions and findAndModify count as commands
500-connection limit; serverless instances each hold a small pool
Sustained ~7 GB per 7 days of the 10 GB Free allowance
Sustained ~7 GB per 7 days of the 10 GB Free allowance (daily capture reads)
The ledger never deletes receipts; any delete is an anomaly (the ledger-app role has no remove)
